scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening theme music and credits roll over backstage imagery for Episode 18.

scenes.title: Travelling Light on Departure
scenes.summary: Having cleared out the chief editor's office overnight without alerting his colleagues, Chun Yuqiao bids a quiet farewell to Xingtian's chairwoman so the company can move ahead unburdened.

scenes.title: Heartbreak Outside and Resolving to Return to Xingtian
scenes.summary: Waiting outside all day, Bu Xiaogu's friend comforts a devastated Xiaogu and explains why taking the blame impulsively hurt proud Chun Yuqiao, inspiring Xiaogu to return and protect everything he built.

scenes.title: Overnight Viral Hosting Sensation
scenes.summary: At a packed fan book club, the host praises Wen Simo's improvised rainstorm commentary on Twelve Singers for turning television's oldest streaming newcomer into a million-follower sensation overnight.

scenes.title: Learning Chun Yuqiao Has Resigned
scenes.summary: Tracking Xingzi down outside Wen Simo's book club, Bu Xiaogu is stunned to learn Chun Yuqiao has resigned and admits she confessed and argued with him at the worst possible moment.

scenes.title: No Turning Back Once the Heart Decides
scenes.summary: Xingzi recounts how Chun Yuqiao once resigned empty-handed from ME after his painful breakup with Luo Lin, explains why his emotional decisions are final, and reveals that she and Kaiwen have resigned too.

scenes.title: Vowing to Guard the Empty Fort
scenes.summary: Confronting Xingtian's chairwoman for keeping Chun Yuqiao's resignation secret to steady the company, Bu Xiaogu vows to guard the empty fort and prove letting him go was a mistake.
scenes.location: Xingtian conference room and chairwoman's office

scenes.title: Putting Away the Ring and Choosing Night Duty
scenes.summary: Returning from abroad with Italian ingredients, Bu Xiaogu's boyfriend notices she put away his ring and admits he courted her with calculated tricks unlike Chun Yuqiao before she heads to Xingtian for night duty.

scenes.title: Midnight Crisis Over a Fraudulent Ad
scenes.summary: Staying overnight in the chief editor's office, Bu Xiaogu fields an urgent call from an advertising representative warning that a fraudulent embedded product ad has implicated Xingtian.

scenes.title: Hospital Scolding and a Rival's Dignified Concession
scenes.summary: At the hospital, Chun Yuqiao promises his doctor not to sneak out again and receives a late-night visit from Bu Xiaogu's former boyfriend, who calmly tells him their relationship has ended.

scenes.title: Old Partners Return to Steady the Crew
scenes.summary: Kaiwen and Xingzi return to the chief editor's office to help Bu Xiaogu, calming anxious crew rumors about Chun Yuqiao and joining forces to protect Wen Simo's talk show reputation.

scenes.title: Helping a Sidelined Star Win a Lead Role
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu proposes helping sidelined actor Rong Silun boost his popularity after the travel show delay by pitching him for the male lead in an upcoming costume drama.

scenes.title: Returning Keepsakes and Donating the Gifted Car
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu returns a box of cherished mementos to her former boyfriend, and when she declines to keep the car he gave her, they warmly agree to donate it to Xin Huimei's charity fund.

scenes.title: Finding Peace in Sports Away From Television
scenes.summary: At an indoor climbing gym, Chun Yuqiao tells Xingtian's chairwoman how relaxed he feels exercising every day and hears how fast Bu Xiaogu has matured before Xiaogu leaves him a voice message.

scenes.title: Asking Wen Simo to Recommend an Actor
scenes.summary: Right after Wen Simo wraps his studio taping, Bu Xiaogu explains why loyal actor Rong Silun missed filming opportunities abroad and persuades Wen Simo to recommend him to the drama director.

scenes.title: Pitching Charity Specials to Restore Trust
scenes.summary: Moments later, Xingzi corners Wen Simo with a crisis plan to produce charity specials for elderly and disabled victims of the false ad, leaving Wen Simo joking that both women are mobbing him before his date.

scenes.title: Wen Simo Reflects Carefreely Over Drinks
scenes.summary: Over drinks, Wen Simo muses lightly about doctors who cannot treat themselves and accepts being carefree and unattached.

scenes.title: Sitting Behind the Chief Producer's Desk
scenes.summary: Invited urgently to Xingtian to prepare an audience-data report, Fentuan boss Ji Xiu teases Bu Xiaogu for lingering behind Chun Yuqiao's desk until Xiaogu admits she upset him.

scenes.title: An Urgent Data Report and Hidden Heartache
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu confides to Ji Xiu her fear that Chun Yuqiao never truly liked her after seeing him happily drinking tea with Wen Simo, then agrees without haggling to pay Fentuan's rush fee.

scenes.title: Celebration Dinner With a Grateful Actor
scenes.summary: Over dinner with Wen Simo and Bu Xiaogu, the grateful actor toasts them as true friends for winning him the costume drama role and promises to help Xingtian whenever needed.

scenes.title: The Lasting Value of Chun Yuqiao's System
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao tells Xingtian's chairwoman that building a self-running editorial system was his four-year goal, while back at Xingtian Bu Xiaogu credits their crisis victory to the workflow he left behind.

scenes.title: Closing Theme Song
scenes.summary: Closing theme music and end credits conclude Episode 18.
